notes:
Summary: Lakemont PW is a mid-market product analytics SaaS building a contextual support assistant and in-app summarization. Started on Redwood Hosted API to move fast; POC confirmed model quality and streaming. Now evaluating Dedicated with VPC for data isolation and predictable throughput.

POC & perf: Hosted API POC (Jan-Feb 2026) ran 2k test conversations, observed 75p latency ~220-280ms for short chat when using streaming + prefix caching. Throughput target: 30-50 req/s for peak dashboards, target p75 <300ms. Cost sensitivity: medium-high — want recommendations for batching, quantization. Customer asked about model options: prefer smaller quantized variants for cost (redwood-7b-q8-style) but may fall back to 13B for complex threads.

Security & compliance ask (main reason for Dedicated push):
- Must support SSO/SAML (Okta) + SCIM provisioning.
- Require SOC2 Type II artifact or equivalent attestation before procurement.
- Audit logs forwarded to customer's SIEM (expects syslog/Kinesis integration).
- Key management: want to use their KMS, confirm HSM/KMS integration options.
- Retention: default retention 90 days for conversational content; legal wants configurable retention and proof of deletion.
- Data residency: US (us-east-1) required for initial roll-out; EU later.

Quotes / call notes: "SE: dedicated gives us the VPC boundary and predictable throughput; infra needs a simple peering setup." "Customer legal: SOC2 report must be provided and support engineers need to see audit logs format."
